title: Coordinate expectation of a monomial
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $i$ be a coordinate in $	ext{Fin }n$, let $S$ be a set of coordinates, and let $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$. The average of the monomial indexed by $S$ over the two choices of the $i$th coordinate is $0$ if $i\in S$, and is the monomial's value at $x$ if $i\notin S$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite set of coordinates
$x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
